customs.title: Customs declarations
customs.purchasePlaceholder: Choose the posted purchase whose goods were cleared

customs.hint: The duty, the excise and the customs fee are part of the goods' cost: the share of goods in stock raises the batch cost (Dt 2910), the share of goods sold goes to the cost of sales (Dt 9120). Import VAT is charged on the customs value with the duty and the excise and is recovered (Dt 4410.5). All of it is owed to the budget through the customs: Kt 6490.

Posting raises the cost of the batches still in stock (Dt 2910), charges the share of goods already sold to the cost of sales (Dt 9120), and moves the share of transferred goods to their batch in the other warehouse.

settlementPolicy.title: Settlements with counterparties
settlementPolicy.byCounterpartyHint: Debt and advances are kept per counterparty: a payment settles any of its debt, and a sale or purchase offsets any of its advances.
settlementPolicy.byContractHint: Debt and advances are kept per contract (like the contract analytics in 1C): a payment settles only the debt of its contract and the rest is an advance under it; a sale or purchase offsets only the advances of its contract. Documents without a contract settle the balances without one.
settlementPolicy.byDocumentHint: Debt and advances are kept by document too (like 1C settlements by document): each sale and purchase is a debt of its own; a bank or cash payment that names a settlement document settles that document only and the rest is an advance; without one the oldest debts are settled first. An advance's document is the payment itself. Balances from before the switch have no document and are settled first.

hint.1: A return is made on a posted purchase: lines, prices, VAT and accounts come from it; enter the quantities only. The goods leave from that purchase's batch (Dt 6010 Ct 2910, VAT Dt 6010 Ct 4410). The debt falls by the purchase price; delivery, duty and other costs added to the batch do not come back and go to Dt 9430. If the batch holds less than the price, the gap is other income (Dr 6010 Cr 9390). The table shows each line's batch value and difference beforehand.
hint.2: A return is made on a posted sale: lines, prices and VAT come from it; enter the quantities only. Revenue goes to 9040, the goods come back at their cost of sale (Dt 9040 Ct 4010, Dt 6410 Ct 4010, Dt 2910 Ct 9120).
hint.3: A return is made on a retail sale: enter the quantities; the money goes back where it was paid.
